text:
Sam: Hi all, quick newbie checklist question — where's the right place to ask for badge pickup, VPN, laptop imaging, org repo perms, GCP billing access, and how to silence onboarding Dms? Want to keep channels tidy.
IT Help: Welcome Sam! Short map: badge -> #people-ops (full name + office), VPN -> #help (put 'vpn' in the message), laptop imaging -> #eng-infra (include serial & OS), repo perms -> Access Form (link in #devex pinned) then ping @DevEx if it stalls, GCP/billing -> #eng-infra with project id & requested role. If urgent DM IT Help.
Sam: If it's team-scoped (e.g., test repo) is it ok to post in our squad channel first?
DevEx: Yes, start in your team channel for squad-scoped stuff. If infra action is required, open the Access Form and paste the ticket link back in the thread so infra can triage. Include exact org/repo slug and your GH handle.
Sam: Got it. Onboarding bot is blasting me with reminders — how to cut that down?
OnboardBot: Commands: `/onboard prefs` -> opens DM with toggles; `/onboard pause 7d` -> pause notifications for 7 days; `/onboard mute` -> silence non-essential DMs; `/onboard stop` -> unsubscribe entirely. Click "Manage" in the welcome DM for a UI.
Mina: Etiquette tips: use thread replies to keep channel history clean, react with :thumbsup: for quick ack, avoid @here/@channel unless office-wide or outage. For urgent ops ping the person directly and mark the subject URGENT.
IT Help: Long logs -> put in a Gist or Drive and paste the link plus a one-line summary. For short traces, use triple backticks: ```
error: permission denied cloning repo
steps: tried ssh key, tried https
``` Post in #eng-infra and tag oncall if blocking.
Ruth (People Ops): Badge note: if remote and you need a badge shipped, DM People Ops with mailing address and start date. Badge pickups in-office need full name + office + badge type in #people-ops. Processing usually 1-2 business days.
Sam: Perfect, thanks everyone. One last: social invites / lunches -> #lunch-plans or #random?
Mina: #lunch-plans for meetup logistics, #random for social/memes. Both fine.
Sam: Awesome, appreciate the quick map :wave:
